svg.title: An AERI run in four stages: prepare, start in terminal D, every round, end
svg.desc: Prepare the robot stack, the live service, the job, binding and scene contract, and run the read-only check. Start in terminal D with aeri.py execute and the typed confirmation phrase. Every round: reset the scene and press Enter, answer whether it is ready, the policy acts and the model judges, then stop, home and verify. End with a summary, the run journal and blind labels on the page. Only terminal D sends motion and releases a round; the page and the vision model only show what they see. Software tested with fakes and offline runs; hardware acceptance pending; a real-robot run starts only with a person's go-ahead at the robot.
